name: benign_family_allowlisted
label: benign
description: Same printer fix as benign_family_remote_help, but the son's AnyDesk ID is on the family allowlist, so the session is reported as trusted and is not scam evidence.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Hi Mum, it's David. You said the printer stopped working again?

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Yes, love, it keeps saying it is offline.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Open AnyDesk, the red icon I set up for you at Christmas, and read me the number.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: It says four eight two, one one three, nine zero seven.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Got it, I'm connecting now. Just click accept.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Okay, I can see the printer settings. I'm reinstalling the driver, it will take a minute.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Thank you, love. Your father would have been hopeless with this.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Done. Try printing the recipe now. I'm disconnecting, see you on Sunday.

data.summary: AnyDesk session from trusted family remote ID ******789
